N5.reading: typical short expressions; kana and basic kanji; concrete familiar information
N5.listening: short familiar conversations spoken slowly; pick out necessary information

N4.reading: familiar daily passages with basic vocabulary and kanji
N4.listening: daily-life conversations generally understood when spoken slowly

N3.reading: specific everyday content and main points of somewhat difficult daily writing
N3.listening: coherent everyday conversations at near-natural speed including relationships

N2.reading: clear material on a variety of general topics; follow narratives and intent
N2.listening: coherent conversations/news at nearly natural speed across broader settings

N1.reading: logically complex or abstract material and profound content across varied topics
N1.listening: natural-speed coherent conversations/news/lectures in broad settings with logical structure and intent
N1.guardrail: Never classify unknown residual items as N1 merely because lower levels lack evidence.
